description: Données de réplication pour: Récupération de l’azote à partir du digestat par décapage-épuration à l’aide d’acide citrique: Effets potentiels de la recirculation et de la postdigestion sur la récupération supplémentaire du biogaz et évaluation du potentiel fertilisant des produits finis is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Catholic University of Leuven. In this Excel data file, the authors share the data from the publication 'Nitrogen recovery from digestate via stripping-scrubbing using citric acid: Potential effects of recirculation and postdigestion on additional biogas recovery, and assessment of the fertilizer potential of end-products'. Coverage: Catholic University of Leuven. The portal shows the English title as "Replication Data for: Nitrogen recovery from digestate via stripping-scrubbing using citric acid: Potential effects of r" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Catholic University of Leuven. Its keywords include Anaerobic digestion, Stripping and scrubbing, Nitrogen recovery, Manure, Ammonia inhibition. The listing shows 2025-09-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
